paragraphs.notes: Markush enumeration table, compound numbers 206 to 232, continued from the preceding page: the page carries no Tabelle caption and no scaffold drawing, only the column header row and the rows. Subscripts are printed as true subscripts (R7a, R7b, R12, R1 as superscript labels; CH2CH2, MeSO2, EtSO2, PrSO2, PhSO2, PhC(O)CH2 with subscript digits); they are flattened to plain text here. The cells are chemical symbols, not German prose, so zh and en are the same string. The R1 column changes value mid-table: rows 206 to 221 are O-c-Bu, rows 222 to 232 are O-c-Pr. The R12 cell of row 217 is printed a little further right than the cells above and below it; the text is the same PhSO2. A small ink speck sits immediately above the O of O-c-Bu in row 207 and a fainter one in the Nr. cell of row 226 and above the 0 of 230; these are scan artifacts, not characters. No abbreviation key is printed on this page, so Bz, Pr and c-Bu are transcribed as printed and not expanded.
